title: Roadtripeado ? Travel & Business Mapping
subtitle: Mapping APIs, business subscriptions and real-time messaging
description: A road-trip directory connecting travellers with locations, local businesses and offers. My backend work covered mapping APIs, business subscriptions, awards and real-time messaging using Express, TypeScript and MongoDB.
highlights: Implemented tiered Stripe subscriptions for business map visibility.
Built location listings, category filters and favourites with MongoDB.
Developed award milestones for achievements and free-map access.
Integrated Socket.io messaging with database-backed chat history.
Added S3/Sharp media uploads, Zod validation, scheduled tasks and Winston logging.
role: Backend development: mapping and filtering APIs, Stripe subscriptions, award milestones, Socket.io messaging and media uploads.
problem: The product brings location discovery, paid business visibility and traveller engagement into one directory.

focus.title: Subscription-based business visibility
focus.body: Implemented tiered Stripe subscriptions so local businesses could list locations and offers on the map.

focus.title: Location discovery and engagement
focus.body: Built location listings, category filtering and favourites with MongoDB, alongside award milestones that unlock achievements and free maps.

focus.title: Messaging and backend operations
focus.body: Integrated Socket.io chat with stored message history, AWS S3 uploads processed with Sharp, Zod validation, scheduled tasks and Winston logging.

Implemented bookmarks, highlights, last-read syncing and Hasanat tracking.
Integrated web and in-app subscription support.
Developed real-time chat, support messaging and push notifications.
Built administrative features for content, user support and subscription analytics.

problem: The application combines multilingual religious content with personal reading progress, paid access and community features.

focus.title: Multilingual content and reading features
focus.body: Built storage and data processing for Quran, Hadith, Tafsir and library content, with bookmarks, highlights, last-read syncing and Hasanat tracking.

focus.title: Web and in-app subscriptions
focus.body: Implemented subscription support for web payments through Stripe and in-app purchases.

focus.title: Communication and administration
focus.body: Integrated real-time chat, support messaging and push notifications, alongside administrative features for content, support and subscription analytics.

title: ClipFrame ? Content Scheduling & Meta Integration
subtitle: Scheduled publishing, background jobs and subscription limits
description: A social content platform for brand onboarding, content planning and Instagram/Facebook publishing. My backend work combined Express and TypeScript APIs with BullMQ/Redis background jobs, Meta integrations, Stripe subscriptions and media storage.
highlights: Built content scheduling and Facebook/Instagram business-page integrations.
Implemented asynchronous background jobs with BullMQ and Redis.
Added Stripe subscription plans with weekly content and business limits.
Supported brand onboarding, reusable templates and content planning.
Integrated media storage, real-time alerts, OAuth and documented APIs.
role: Backend development: content scheduling, Facebook/Instagram integrations, BullMQ/Redis jobs, subscription limits and API documentation.
problem: Businesses need to manage brand assets, plan content and schedule publishing while staying within their subscription limits.

focus.title: Planning and social publishing
focus.body: Implemented content workflows for weekly planners and reusable templates, with scheduling for Instagram and Facebook and reminder triggers.

focus.title: Background processing and media
focus.body: Used BullMQ and Redis for asynchronous jobs, AWS S3 and Cloudinary for media storage, and Socket.io for real-time alerts.

focus.title: Access, limits and documentation
focus.body: Integrated Stripe plan management and weekly content limits, Passport OAuth, rate limiting and Swagger API documentation.

Implemented AI recipe interactions with daily usage limits.
Added Stripe subscriptions, trial eligibility and billing management.
Integrated REST/WebSocket APIs with the Flutter mobile application.
Supported administrative views for platform, subscription and revenue data.

focus.title: Tracking and recipe features
focus.body: Built cycle-phase and calendar features, meal/workout logs, grocery lists and pantry management, alongside AI recipe recommendations with save, favourite, swipe and daily usage limits.

focus.title: Subscription lifecycle

focus.title: Mobile and admin integration
focus.body: Integrated REST and WebSocket APIs with the Flutter application and supported administrative statistics, subscription analytics and revenue views.

focus.title: Backend and loyalty features
